issues.on_page: Local Fees, Licenses, Commissions, and Miscellaneous 809,889
issues.issue: Mixed label. The Statement of Activities (pp2-3) counts 689,470 as charges for services, 546,813 of it Inheritance Tax, and 120,419 as general receipts. Licenses and permits is not the dominant part. The category comes from the user's 2026-10-23 decision, so it is left as a judgment call.
'Local' is a context label. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Road charges for services 8,305, which is more than half, so the extractor rule points to charges for services.
The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Bridge charges for services 25,647 (69%), so the rule points to charges for services rather than other.
The Statement of Activities (p2) shows S.T.O.P. charges for services 78 (100%), so this is charges for services, not other.
The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Reg Deeds P & M charges for services 1,901 (100%), so this is charges for services, not other.
The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Ambulance charges for services 25,318 (96%), so the category should be Ambulance Fees or charges for services, not other.
